shots.focal_element: Centered headline 'A customer just chose' with a pill-shaped 'YOUR COMPETITOR' tag beneath it
shots.transition_other: video open: starts on an empty off-white frame, no transition from a prior shot
shots.typography: Clean geometric/grotesk sans, regular-to-medium weight, sentence case headline with normal tracking; the tag is small all-caps with slightly open tracking inside a rounded pill (font guess, low confidence: Inter-like)
shots.what_happens: On an empty off-white canvas the headline builds word by word in sync with the VO (w0-w5): 'A customer' then 'just chose'; a small outlined pill 'YOUR COMPETITOR' scales up beneath it and by ~2.0s flips to a filled black pill with light text as 'competitor' (w5) is spoken.
shots.build_rebuild: On a flat off-white background, reveal headline words one at a time on their VO word timestamps, then scale a small outlined all-caps pill up from ~60% to 100% below the headline and swap its fill from transparent to solid black (text inverts) on the keyword.

shots.focal_element: Typewriter line 'because AI told them to.' in light text on black
shots.transition_other: instant cut from the off-white canvas to full black with the typewriter line already starting (reads as a hard cut / colour inversion)
shots.typography: Same sans as s001, regular weight, lowercase sentence fragment, normal tracking, light-on-dark; a text caret is visible while typing
shots.what_happens: The palette inverts to black; 'because AI told them to.' is typed on character by character with a blinking caret, tracking the VO (w6-w10), then holds through the pause and the spoken 'Why?' (w11). At the very end (~5.0s) a corner of the frame begins peeling/folding over, revealing a lilac back face and the off-white next scene.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a black full-frame layer, type the line character by character with a caret synced to VO word starts, hold, then animate a page-curl/fold from the bottom-right corner whose back face is lilac to reveal the next scene underneath.

shots.focal_element: Floating dark website/case-study cards in 3D space flown through by the camera, ending on AI brand marks and an orange arch
shots.transition_other: page-curl/fold wipe from s002: the black frame peels from the bottom-right corner (lilac back face) to reveal this off-white scene
on_screen_text: The most beautiful user-centered website on the internet.
shots.typography: UI cards use the same clean sans: small all-caps label 'YOUR WEBSITE', medium sentence-case headings, centered body line, large light-weight numerals for '200X' and '114%' with an arrow glyph, small pill labels 'Case Study'; the '?' is a very large bold black glyph. Some small card body text is too small to read
shots.what_happens: Off-white space with radial speed lines: a large black '?' sits beside a cluster of small dark UI cards (a 'YOUR WEBSITE' pricing page, a hero card, '200X' and '114%' case-study stat cards). The '?' swings off right while the camera pushes forward through the cards as the VO says customers are not visiting your website or reading case studies (w12-w21): the website cards rush past and blur, then the case-study cards ('200X', '114% ↑', bar chart) enlarge and fly past with depth-of-field blur. Behind them three small AI marks (an OpenAI-like knot, a four-point sparkle, a Perplexity-like mark) grow in turn as 'chat GPT, perplexity, and Google' is spoken (w24-w28); each flies past with motion blur until only the sparkle remains, which stretches out of frame while a black bar becomes a rising orange arch/doorway shape (w29-w32 'AI decides for them') that scales up toward the camera.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a 3D scene (perspective camera) with dark rounded UI-card planes and three logo sprites placed at increasing z-depth along a vanishing point, add thin radial speed-line strokes, and dolly the camera forward through each layer on VO word cues with depth-of-field blur on near objects, ending on an orange arched rectangle that scales up to fill the frame.

shots.focal_element: Words 'That's the problem.' on a full orange field
shots.typography: Same sans, regular-to-medium weight, sentence case, dark text on orange; words start in a descending diagonal stair-step and then settle onto one line with wide word spacing
shots.what_happens: The orange arch from s003 has grown to fill almost the whole frame (thin off-white edges still visible at 15.5s) and then fills it entirely. 'That's', 'the', 'problem.' appear one by one in a diagonal stagger synced to w33-w35, then slide together into a single centred line that holds.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the orange arched shape until it covers the frame, reveal three words on their VO timestamps at stepped offsets down and to the right, then animate them with an ease-in-out into a single centred baseline.

shots.focal_element: Full-bleed colour planes: the orange field tilting away and light-blue panels rising
shots.transition_other: diagonal plane wipe: the orange field tilts and drops away along a diagonal edge, revealing an off-white field
shots.what_happens: A short colour-wipe bridge: the orange plane slides out along a diagonal at the bottom of an off-white frame, while light-blue horizontal panels rise from the bottom and cover the frame by ~18.5s, under VO 'Your site was built for people' (w36-w41). Purpose of the blue panels is not identifiable from these frames; it likely sets up the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Rotate and translate the orange full-frame plane downward off-screen along a ~15 degree diagonal over ~0.6s while two stacked light-blue rectangles slide up from the bottom edge to cover the frame.
